## 🌡️ MARKET OVERVIEW

1. What is the prevailing Global Risk Regime?
NEUTRAL. Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive (Sector Weakness). Confirmation: weak sector breadth (3/11) and broad divergence among large caps (multiple TREND EXHAUSTION / RECOVERY cases) support a neutral, wait-for-confirmation stance.

2. Which sectors are leading?
Healthcare leads: AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) RECOVERY, DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND. Materials showing lift: ECL (1W: +3.80% | 1M: -1.73%) RECOVERY. Consumer Staples mild positive: WMT (1W: +1.20% | 1M: +5.94%) ABOVE TREND.

3. Which sectors are lagging?
Financials lag: MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -4.90%) BELOW TREND, SCHW (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND. Technology lagging on the week: ACN (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.89%) BELOW TREND, ADBE (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.11%) BELOW TREND, ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND. Industrials weak: BA (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -12.15%) BELOW TREND.

## 📈 STOCK PERFORMANCE

4. Top Performing Stocks?
Top 5: AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND; DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND; EMR (1W: +5.06% | 1M: +1.07%) ABOVE TREND; AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND. Leadership: Concentrated (3 sectors in Top 5). Style: mixed / no clear leadership.

5. Worst Performing Stocks?
Bottom 5: MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND; ACN (1W: -6.25% | 1M: -6.89%) BELOW TREND; WFC (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -4.90%) BELOW TREND; ADBE (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.11%) BELOW TREND; SCHW (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND — weakness concentrated in Financials and select large-cap Tech.

6. Momentum Stocks?
Best 1W movers: AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) RECOVERY; PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND; DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND. Note MAJOR divergence: multiple large caps show 1W vs 1M mismatches (AAPL, GOOGL, META, SHOP, NVDA) — tactical moves, not clear market-confirming momentum.

## 🏭 SECTOR OUTLOOK

7. Technology Outlook?
Mixed/soft on the week: PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND vs ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND and ADBE (1W: -7.42% | 1M: -20.11%) BELOW TREND; Tech showing INTERNAL ROTATION and several large-cap TREND EXHAUSTION cases.

8. Financials Outlook?
Weak: MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND, WFC (1W: -6.62% | 1M: -4.90%) BELOW TREND, JPM (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND — sector breadth negative and leadership absent.

9. Healthcare Outlook?
Cautious constructive: DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, LLY (1W: +1.71% | 1M: +0.74%) ABOVE TREND, JNJ (1W: +0.92% | 1M: +2.33%) ABOVE TREND with several RECOVERY names (AMGN (1W: +6.35% | 1M: -4.32%) RECOVERY, NVS (1W: +4.18% | 1M: -5.02%) RECOVERY) — defensive bid inside a mixed market.

## 🧭 PORTFOLIO STRATEGY

10. Portfolio Recommendation?
NEUTRAL posture: favor selective exposure to Healthcare and Materials names showing ABOVE TREND/RECOVERY (DHR, AMGN, ECL) and reduce exposure to large-cap Tech and Financial names showing confirmed BELOW TREND (ADBE, ORCL, MS, SCHW); style mixed / no clear leadership until divergence resolves.

## 🔮 NEXT WEEK OUTLOOK

11. Stocks to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: NVDA (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND — watch reaction to buyback headline; PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND for follow-through; DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND. BEARISH: BA (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -12.15%) BELOW TREND; ORCL (1W: -10.74% | 1M: -12.73%) BELOW TREND; MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND.

12. Sectors to Watch Next Week?
BULLISH: Healthcare (sector 1W +1.69%, 17 stocks) — pick up in defensive/capital-light names. BEARISH: Financials (sector 1W -3.03%, 20 stocks) and Technology (sector 1W -1.82%, 24 stocks) — both showing notable large-cap stress.

13. Key Levels & Triggers?
NVDA: watch hold above prior consolidation/psychological level (monitor for confirmation on buyback follow-through) — NVDA (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND; AAPL support watch ~recent pullback zone — AAPL (1W: -0.17% | 1M: +7.57%) CORRECTION; MS breakout/failure around recent lows will matter — MS (1W: -6.05% | 1M: -9.88%) BELOW TREND.

## 📰 NEWS SENTIMENT MOVERS

14. Bullish Sentiment Stocks?
NVDA (+98): Nvidia announces $150B buyback — NVDA (1W: +0.65% | 1M: +0.50%) ABOVE TREND, news confirmed by size of catalyst but price reaction muted — watch follow-through. SCHW (+50): Charles Schwab opening private markets — SCHW (1W: -8.03% | 1M: -9.02%) BELOW TREND, news diverging from price. JPM (+50): QIA partnership headline — JPM (1W: -4.39% | 1M: -4.98%) BELOW TREND, sentiment not yet reflected in price.

15. Bearish Sentiment Stocks?
BA (-55): FAA certification report — BA (1W: -8.33% | 1M: -12.15%) BELOW TREND, sentiment confirmed by heavy selling. NVS (-50): CAR-T pause headline — NVS (1W: +4.18% | 1M: -5.02%) RECOVERY, news is bearish while price moved up on the week — divergence to monitor. MRK (-60): cancer filing withdrawal (sentiment large negative) — watch MRK price action for confirmation (major negative catalyst).

## 📝 EXECUTIVE SUMMARY

NEUTRAL with style mixed / no clear leadership; Breadth: 3/11 sectors positive. DHR (1W: +5.32% | 1M: +5.40%) ABOVE TREND, PANW (1W: +5.47% | 1M: +2.41%) ABOVE TREND and AMAT (1W: +4.85% | 1M: +0.91%) ABOVE TREND showing relative strength. Key risk: MAJOR divergence across large caps (AAPL/GOOGL/META TREND EXHAUSTION and NVDA buyback headline with muted follow-through) — monitor sentiment vs price for confirmation.
